description: Turn any selection into a halftone dot field and place it back on the board. Draw it as dots or pixels, dithered with Floyd–Steinberg, Bayer 4, Bayer 8, blue noise or a hard threshold, with circle or square dots. The pixel style can keep the source's own colours. Tune grid, cell and dot size, vignette, posterize, levels, gamma, floor, ceiling and softness, then pick ink and paper colours. You can also drop or paste an image into the panel.
